messages:
jamie: Quick postmortem follow-up for the vendor outages (cloud auth spike + model-registry flaps). Capturing owners + short timelines so we can close actions.

jamie: Actions I sketched: 1) registry auth fallback shim + feature-flag, 2) cloud retry/backoff + circuit breaker, 3) lightweight registry canary + dashboard, 4) monthly vendor SLA review + quarterly drill. Pick owners pls.

anya: I'll own #1 (fallback shim). Plan: adaptor that prefers cached model-metadata when auth errors >5/min, feature-flag `registry_fallback_v1`, PR by Fri. Will add integration tests.

mike: I'll take #2 (retry/backoff + circuit). Start conservative backoffs, add a failure-count circuit to flip to fallback after 10s of sustained 5xx. Staging rollout next Tue.

anya: also adding a short-circuit token-stretch suggestion so clients avoid refresh storms (TTL hint + 2m stretch). I'll document hazards in the PR.

sre-bot: reminder: add 15m on-call ack SLA for vendor-auth regressions and update PD escalation.

jamie: thanks. @ops-team can you add a recurring calendar event for monthly vendor SLA reviews?

ops-team: added recurring event "Vendor SLA Review" first meeting 2026-05-12.

anya: PR posted: https://git.internal/repo/registry-fallback/pull/121 (includes config, tests, rollout notes).

mike: ticket created: https://tickets.internal/INC-6218 assigned to mike, anya, jamie (due 2026-05-10) 
 includes PR links + canary plan.

jamie: @everyone please add a one-line status to the postmortem doc by EOD Fri; I'll compile a short follow-up tracker and share with leadership. If timelines shift ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
